description: NaY₃F₁₀ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mmc space group. Na is bonded to twelve F atoms to form corner-sharing NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.62-2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to ten F atoms. There are eight shorter (2.30 Å) and two longer (2.83 Å) Y-F bond lengths. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to eleven F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.84 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Y atoms to form distorted FNa₂Y₄ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent FNa₂Y₄ octahedra, corners with twenty-four equivalent FNaY₃ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent FNa₂Y₄ octahedra, and faces with eight equivalent FNaY₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na and three Y atoms to form FNaY₃ tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₂Y₄ octahedra, corners with sixteen equivalent FNaY₃ tetrahedra, edges with six equivalent FNaY₃ tetrahedra, and faces with two FNa₂Y₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-65°. In the third F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Y atoms to form FNa₂Y₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FNa₂Y₄ octahedra, corners with twenty-four equivalent FNaY₃ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent FNa₂Y₄ octahedra, and faces with eight equivalent FNaY₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°.
